snippet.title: This game takes 72 hours to beat - Dungeon Prisoner Simulator
snippet.description:
Dungeon Prisoner Simulator is a game that takes 72 real world hours to beat. Sure, most of it is serving your sentence, but don't ignore it too long....

Coming to Steam October 21st.

Check it out here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5364370
